## Findings
- [ ] **[BLOCK][Docs] Add migration notes for the v0.9.0 public API additions**

The unreleased diff adds `embedkit.Result`, quantization-aware `SameSpace`, providers, configurable result caching, dimension pinning, `ollamakit.EmbedWithDim`, and consumer version-drift guidance.
